newsitem.title: USA: Revco completes Big B tender, owns 84 pct.
newsitem.headline: Revco completes Big B tender, owns 84 pct.

text.p: Revco D.S. Inc on Friday said it now owns about 84 percent of Big B Inc, after completing a cash tender offer for all of the outstanding shares of Big B at $17.25 a share.

Revco said that, as of the tender's expiration this morning, 16.1 million shares had been tendered and accepted for payment. Revco will now proceed to complete a merger with Big B, offering $17.25 per share for the remaining shares.
The merger between the retail drugstores chains is expected to be completed late this year or early next year, Revco said.
